racing_title.text: The tire grip physics in the rain feel unrealistically slippery when using a force feedback steering wheel.
Severe micro-stuttering and FPS drops when more than 12 cars are on the screen during Monaco turns.
The V10 engine roar and exhaust crackles sound phenomenal with 3D spatial audio headphones.
Cars are locked behind a ridiculous 40-hour grind unless you buy the premium car pass tokens.
Multiplayer ghosting causes cars behind me to teleport through my bumper at 200 mph.
We need more historical circuits like Silverstone 1988 and Watkins Glen in the next content update.
Steering wheel force feedback deadzone is completely broken after the latest v1.4 patch.
Game crashes directly to desktop on PC when transitioning from qualifying to the main race grid.

fps_title.text: Bullet hit registration is completely desynced; I dumped a full magazine into an enemy and did zero damage.
Weapon recoil patterns feel crisp, punchy, and reward tap-firing at long range.
Memory leak causes the game to consume 16GB of VRAM and crash after three competitive matches.
$25 for an animated weapon camo skin in the store is outrageous price gouging.
Enemy footstep directional audio is muffled and impossible to pinpoint in building interiors.
Ranked queue times take over 8 minutes even in peak European server hours.
Slide canceling and mantle animations feel smooth and responsive in close-quarters combat.
When are we getting the promised 6v6 Search and Destroy maps teased in the launch roadmap?

livestream_posts.text: Stream quality is lagging and audio is out of sync with the developer interview.
The new lighting engine and weather effects shown in the gameplay trailer look gorgeous!
Please fix cross-play voice chat echo between Xbox party chat and Discord.
Will the upcoming expansion DLC be included on Xbox Game Pass on day one?
The time-to-kill looks way too fast compared to the previous game in the franchise.
Show us the custom race track creator and community browser features please!
Is this running at native 4K 60fps or using dynamic resolution scaling with FSR?
Guns sound like toy airsoft rifles, please bring back the heavy bass sound effects.
